_comment: The Warrior's retail-style talent trees (format: localTools/oathblade/talentTree.json, the Priest's layout): a
class tree and the three WotLK specializations, in the order of their talent tabs (Armes, Fureur, Protection),
then the Gladiateur, which has no talent tab of its own (mod-custom-classes gives the stock systems Protection's),
which is the order the bots take them in. Nodes marked existing reuse the WotLK talents' own spells or name an
ability authored in localTools/warrior/Spells.ps1; the others are generated by
localTools/talentTree/TalentRankSpells.ps1 and read by modules/mod-warrior. The Warrior keeps rage and fights in
any stance (localTools/warrior/StockSpells.ps1). Each spec learns its core abilities and a hidden passive
(specSpells): Arms Mortal Strike, Fury Bloodthirst, Raging Blow and Titan's Grip, Protection Shield Slam,
Devastate and Ignore Pain. botBuild is the order a bot takes its nodes in; presets are the recommended
single-target and AoE builds (bots take the AoE one in dungeons). Ids 95000-95099 are the new talent ranks.
